This repository's history was rewritten on 16 Nov 2026 to replace a personal
email address with a GitHub noreply address in the author and committer of
every commit where it appeared. In the 24 earliest versions of
examples/illumination_texture.py, one comment that pointed to a file not in
this repository was reworded. No other content and no commit message changed.
Every commit hash changed as a result. Old hashes cited elsewhere resolve
through this file, which maps each old hash to its new one.
